title: SwapFaces.ai review: pricing, privacy and alternatives
summary: SwapFaces.ai review covering photo and video face swap, one-time credits, privacy, adult-content access, commercial use, and alternatives.
body_markdown:
## Quick answer


**SwapFaces.ai is worth considering for adults seeking one-time credits and long-form face-swap options. Its clearest strength is photo, gif, multi-face and video workflows plus an api. The main limitation is the service is adults-only and includes explicit-content tools, making it unsuitable for many teams. Magic Hour is the stronger fit when you want image, GIF and video face swap inside a broader image, video and audio workspace.**


This vendor-authored review was checked against[SwapFaces.ai official product and policy pages](https://www.swapfaces.ai/) on September 20, 2026. Magic Hour publishes this guide and is included as an alternative. It is a documentation review, not a retained cross-tool quality benchmark.


## What is SwapFaces.ai?


SwapFaces.ai is an AI face-swap product for replacing a face in an image or video. Photo, GIF, multi-face and video workflows plus an API. Use only media you own or have permission to edit, and obtain explicit consent from every identifiable person.


## What SwapFaces.ai does well


Adults seeking one-time credits and long-form face-swap options. Its workflow removes much of the manual masking and compositing required by conventional editing. That convenience does not prove every output is accurate: inspect eyes, teeth, hairlines, skin edges, occlusion, lighting and identity across the full clip.


## SwapFaces.ai pricing and access


SwapFaces says paid credits are a one-time purchase and never expire. Its pricing page lists HD exports, commercial rights and a 30-day refund when no more than 20% of credits have been used. Unlimited plans cover specific tools rather than the full suite, so confirm which workflow consumes credits.


## Privacy, consent and commercial use


The July 3, 2026 privacy policy says uploads and generated content are deleted within 24 hours, except content flagged by safety systems or reported by users. The service is restricted to adults and requires explicit consent for real-person material.


A commercial-use label does not clear publicity, copyright, trademark or contractual rights. Keep written consent, source licenses and disclosure records. Never use face swap to impersonate, deceive, harass or create intimate imagery without consent.

## How to test SwapFaces.ai fairly


Use one permitted portrait, one difficult side angle and one short motion clip. Keep resolution, duration and source files constant. Record attempts, processing time, charged credits, watermarks, export resolution and whether the output was usable without manual repair.


Reject outputs with identity drift, unstable jaw or hair boundaries, flicker, incorrect occlusion, changed expression, altered skin tone or artifacts around glasses and hands. Compare cost per accepted output rather than cost per generation.


## Verdict


SwapFaces.ai has a defensible place for adults seeking one-time credits and long-form face-swap options. The service is adults-only and includes explicit-content tools, making it unsuitable for many teams. Test one representative job and verify current policies before committing sensitive media or recurring production.
